To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dialogue control of a health oriented smartwatch app has to take into consideration three dimensions, namely (1) the simultaneity of the health hazard and the intended assistance functionality, (2) the ethical considerations how to put the wearer always in full control, and (3) the mandatory acceptance conditions.
the reinforcement learning based behavioral acceptance patterns approach is an appropriate approach to improve the dialogue design and control for smartwatch apps.
reinforcement learning based behavioral acceptance patterns are a promising approach to improve dialogue design and control of health oriented smartwatch applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a dialogue system, which is capable to learn from the user and to adapt its behavior accordingly.
the design and control of a dialogue system for a smartwatch app, that is able to learn from the user over time, when the app is expected to intervene and when it should remain silent.
the question of how a smartwatch app can be controlled in a way that it is accepted by the wearer and still is effective in the assistance of health hazards.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the smartwatch app has to learn to decide autonomously when and how to intervene in order to achieve the intended assistance functionality of an app for elderly people.
the smartwatch app will learn to behave according to the acceptance patterns of the smartwatch user.
the app has to learn from the wearer the appropriate timing of interventions and their acceptance by the wearer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a reinforcement learning based approach for the learning of behavioral acceptance patterns for health related smartwatch apps.
we have developed a smartwatch app that learns over time to assist its user in a health oriented way, while always respecting the user’s autonomy and privacy.

we are able to design a smartwatch app for health assistance, which is able to detect health hazards and to decide when to intervene and when to remain silent in a way, that the user will always feel in control of his own health.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reinforcement learning based approach is a viable option to realize the acceptance conditions of the smartwatch health app.
the machine learning approach will allow the app to learn from the wearer and will adapt its interventions to the wearer over time.
the app will learn the behavioral acceptance patterns of the user over time and will adapt the dialogue control strategy to these acceptance patterns.
